title: Camelot Receipt
description: v1.2 receipt. Every consequential state transition emits a receipt; receipts are hash-linked into a per-tenant chain whose head is written to the ledger anchor every N entries (default N=1000). See Camelot-OS SADD+LLDD v1.2 §11.3.

parent_hash.description: SHA-256 of the immediately preceding receipt in the tenant chain. The genesis receipt MUST use the literal value 'sha256:' followed by 64 zero hex characters.

self_hash.description: Recommended. SHA-256 over the canonical serialization of this receipt with self_hash and signature fields stripped. Servers may recompute and reject on mismatch.

chain_height.description: Monotonic, per-tenant. The genesis receipt has chain_height=0.

authority_epoch.description: Monotonic epoch under which this receipt was issued; receivers REJECT receipts whose epoch is below trusted epoch (§6.3).

actor.description: Who produced the receipt. node_trust_band is the band under which this receipt was emitted and is required for downstream verification of dual-write safety.

event.description: Stable verb describing what this receipt attests to (e.g. 'lease.issued', 'patch.applied', 'cache.write', 'cache.evict', 'gideon.pass').

refs.description: Cross-references to other receipts and identifiers relevant to this event.

payload_redacted.description: Role-scoped projection of the underlying event payload. Receivers see only what their role permits. Schema is open within reason; downstream policy decides which fields are surfaced.

ledger_anchor_eligible.description: True when this receipt's chain_height mod default_anchor_interval == 0 (default 1000), making it eligible for the next ledger anchor write.

effect_class.description: Closed set per §5.5 of Camelot-OS SADD+LLDD v1.2.

risk_tier.description: Risk tier per §5.5 of Camelot-OS SADD+LLDD v1.2. Required quorum rises with tier; T3+ requires two distinct operator approvals; T4 additionally requires witness promotion lock or external-confirmation token.

trust_band.description: Node trust band per §7.3 of Camelot-OS SADD+LLDD v1.2.
